info.name: DalCor Pharmaceuticals Content API (WordPress REST API) Media API

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. `edit` requires authentication and returns 401 anonymously.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: after
params.description: Limit response to items published after a given ISO 8601 date.

params.name: before
params.description: Limit response to items published before a given ISO 8601 date.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure the result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit the result set to specific IDs.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the result set by a specific number of items.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit the result set to items with one or more specific slugs.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Sparse fieldset — comma-separated list of top-level fields to return, e.g. `_fields=id,slug,title,link,date`.

params.name: wpml_language
params.description: WPML language code. The site publishes an English and a French edition; `en` returns 24 posts / 17 pages and `fr` returns 6 posts / 15 pages (observed 2026-08-04).

params.name: media_type
params.description: Limit result set to attachments of a particular media type.

params.name: mime_type
params.description: Limit result set to attachments of a particular MIME type.

items.docs: 54 attachments observed on 2026-08-04 — logos, trial poster assets and PDFs.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique integer identifier for the object.
